desc:
Welcome to the New Escape The School Obby! We've been in maths class for the whole day... SOOO BOOOORING! Let's find a way to escape. Can you make it out without being caught by the teachers?  Can you beat the 31 challenging obby stages and ESCAPE SCHOOL???

👍 Like and favourite our game if you enjoyed it! More obby stages will be released every week!



Tags: School, Highschool, Obby, Parkour, Obstacle course, Adventure, Obby
